claim: Amazon S3 supports IPv6 for gateway and interface VPC endpoints (What's New, posted Nov 10, 2025): you configure the IP address type of a new or existing S3 gateway or interface endpoint to IPv6 or Dualstack.
question: Do Amazon S3 gateway and interface VPC endpoints support IPv6, and since when?

values.display: supports IPv6 for gateway and interface VPC endpoints
values.spoken: S3 gateway and interface endpoints support IPv6
set the endpoint IP address type to IPv6 or dual stack

qualifiers.scope: Amazon S3 gateway and interface VPC endpoints

evidence.quote: Amazon S3 now supports Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) addresses for AWS PrivateLink gateway and interface Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) endpoints.

evidence.heading: Amazon S3 now supports IPv6 for gateway and interface VPC endpoints

evidence.quote: To get started with IPv6 connectivity on a new or existing S3 gateway or interface endpoint, configure IP address type for the endpoint to IPv6 or Dualstack.

note: Repaired by adjudicate-10 after a currency vote of outdated: the VPC guide IPv6 support table (aws-ipv6-support) still shows No for S3 private endpoints and lags the 2025-11-10 announcement; teach the announcement. GA 2025-11-10 is before the 2026-07-15 cutoff, so it is examinable. Chapter 11 owns endpoints.
